pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useModuleActions.ts:41 useModuleActions.sendPromptToModule, and the public sendPrompt returned by useModuleCLI, send caller-supplied prompt text straight to the terminal. The callers are ActivityFeedPanel and GlobalSearchPanel, which replay old prompts. That text never passes through composeTaskDispatch/buildTaskPrompt, so the single-assembler door is not sealed: the text is not re-assembled against the current project context, the variant or the budget.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useModuleActions.ts:41 execute() goes through the assembler, but a second door dispatches pre-rendered prompt text. That is the call-site sprawl the technique names.

src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:121 The ledger stores the pre-dispatch string, but useTaskQueue sends dispatchPrompt with skill packs injected later (useTaskQueue.ts:817). The record is therefore not of the bytes sent and has no digest. Line 115 also infers context inclusion by substring sniffing ('## Project Context'), not from a fingerprint.

src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:218 On the preferred path the hook passes the assembler typed context inputs (a ProjectContext shape) plus a CLITask, not rendered text. The trust-class side is not visible in this hook.

declined.subject: prompt-assembly
declined.reason: None of the 18 listed files builds or sends a prompt; they are schema, slot and version UI. The only prompt site in the directory is sub_save/schema/SaveHeaderAudit.tsx (buildSaveFixPrompt into TaskFactory.askClaude), which is not in the context's file list. A not-applicable claim would be refused, because 'prompt' appears in that directory, and judging an unlisted file would be off-context.
